source: &1360 When people worry, there's always something they find to help them.
target: &1360 人有了烦心事，总会找点什么来排解。

source: &1361 Drinking, the Trance, even God sometimes.
target: &1361 喝酒，泡迷境，有时甚至求助于上帝。

source: &1362 Me, I've got a place I like to go to. It's helped me when I've been troubled in the past.
target: &1362 而我，有个喜欢去的地方。以前心烦的时候，它帮了我不少。

source: &377 The tree's unusual constitution causes it to shed its leaves more often than a natural specimen. You diligently tend to the mess it makes as often as work allows.
target: &377 这棵树的体质特殊，落叶比天然树木更频繁。只要工作允许，你就会尽心清理这些落叶。

source: &293 You're not in the mood for gardening.
target: &293 你现在没心情打理花园。

source: &379 The storage locker for your gardening tools.
target: &379 存放园艺工具的储物柜。

source: &2087 It's empty.
&1368 I'd better not put it away, I might need it!
target: &1368 还是别收起来了，说不定用得上！

source: &383 Not even having to glance for a moment, those words are etched in a memory deeper than anything else:
target: &383 不必再看一眼。那些字，比任何记忆都刻得更深：

source: &384 Viksha Regis - beloved wife, friend to all that lives.[[11 August 2034 - 2 January 2067[['Think of us not as engineers, but as artists.'
target: &384 维克莎·里吉斯——挚爱的妻子，所有生灵的朋友。[[2034年8月11日—2067年1月2日[[“请把我们看作艺术家，而非工程师。”

source: &2000 The way out.
Better not move it. It's where it ought to be.
target: 最好别动它。它就该待在这里。

source: &2001 I'm not climbing that. It's sickly enough as it is.
target: &2001 我可不爬。它已经够虚弱了。

source: &2002 It took a lot of work to make, but it was worth it.
target: &2002 培育它费了不少工夫，不过值得。

source: &2003 This gengineered tree is the kind of memorial I think she'd appreciate.
target: &2003 这棵经过基因改造的树，我想，她会喜欢这样的纪念。

source: You're fortunate to have gotten a garden this high up. The view just about clears the city's forest of skyscrapers, and on a good day the Indian Ocean is visible from your bench.
target: 能在这么高的地方拥有一座花园，是你的幸运。这里刚好能越过城市的高楼丛林，天气好时，坐在长椅上就能看见印度洋。

source: You aren't in the mood for a visit to that neighboorhood. Down in that part of town, it's all restaurants and corporate headquarters.
target: 你现在没心情去那一片城区。下面那片地方，到处都是餐厅和公司总部。
